description: You are an AP Statistics teacher preparing a data analysis lesson on the relationship between national income and population health outcomes. A CSV file with GNI per capita (PPP) and life expectancy data for 15 countries, taken from the United Nations Human Development Report 2021-22, has been pre-staged at ~/Documents/GeoGebra/data/world_development.csv. Using GeoGebra, enter this data into the Spreadsheet view (or directly as a list), create a scatter plot of GNI per capita (x-axis) vs. life expectancy in years (y-axis), fit both a linear regression model using FitLine and a logarithmic regression model using FitLog to compare which fits the data better, and annotate the visualization with text labels showing the regression equations. The scatter plot should include all 15 data points. Save as 'world_regression.ggb' in ~/Documents/GeoGebra/projects/
